answer: On the tundra, every identity must carry one jade seal across the canyon, and the k-th seal costs the k-th Catalan number of jade chips: the first pays 1, the second 2, the third 5, the tenth 16,796, so ten identities pay 23,713. Only one crossing is allowed per day, so the hundredth fake waits 99 days, and its seal costs more jade than the ninety-nine before it combined.
